title: Antiferromagnetic domain wall dynamics in rotating magnetic fields engineered by bending and twisting
task: Model antiferromagnetic domain wall dynamics in helical structures driven by rotating fields
key_results: Two distinct motion modes: (i) rigid DW motion at low frequency with constant velocity, (ii) oscillatory motion with precession at high frequency; geometric chirality determines phase rotation direction; DW velocity tunable via field frequency and geometric manipulations
comments: Elegant reduction of 3D curvilinear problem to effective biaxial dynamics; geometry-dependent mobility offers design tool for curvilinear spintronics.

model_io.model: helical antiferromagnet in circularly polarized field

hypotheses.hypothesis: Helix geometry enables tunable DW motion via field frequency and geometric manipulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; two distinct dynamical regimes identified
